title: The Battle of the Diets: Is Anyone Winning (At Losing?)
summary: Stanford's Christopher Gardner presents his large, long comparison of four popular diets under real-world conditions, in which the lowest-carbohydrate Atkins diet came out on top.
why: Recommended as a researcher presenting actual diet-study results, including a trial with 311 women on different diet books.

quote.text: Here's a researcher presenting the results of their study as well as discussing several others[1].
